items.title: Allan Jaffe Interview, 1969-04-16
items.q: Well, we met Bill before, because the musicians had gone into Bill's shop.

ctx.x: All right, today is April 16th, 1969, and I'm interviewing Alan Jaffe. Okay, Alan, could you tell me the story about how Preservation Hall started? Larry, Larry Borson had sessions in the hall, and was in his art gallery, associated artists, and I think about five years, going back to about 19, I think it was 1955 or 7, somewhere around there, where he started having Punch come over and play. Kid Thomas was playing there, and the Bazooka Trio used to play in Power of Ryan, and Patio, and they used to come over…
Do you think she really picked up my stupid thing? I don't know.

items.title: Betty Lee Hanson, Joe James, George Lewis, Joe Lewis, Joe Butler, Kid Thomas Valentine, Bill Russell, Allan…
items.q: The only way we really know about the men are still around are through people like Mr. Russell and people who do come around.

ctx.x: How'd you get the idea to come down here and start this New Orleans revival of jazz or work with it? Well, we didn't come down here for that specific purpose. We came down from Philadelphia in about April and thought we'd be hearing a lot of these musicians and a lot of this music. And we didn't. We knew a lot of these men were still alive, that bands like the Eureka and Young Tuxedo Brass bands were still organized, and they were not playing anywhere. The first time that we saw them was about a month later. We…

Well, really, when we started, there was a group of people involved in this person we rent from now, Larry Bornstein, had been running these sessions on an informal basis. That would be, I guess, for at least 10 years. The band would come in occasionally during the night when they weren't playing. He'd open up his gallery to them and pass the kitty and pay them in from that. Mr. Russell had been down here for quite a while doing research on the musicians. And a boy here from California by the name of Grayson…
How did you get hold of these men in the first place? Did they find out about you?
